label: PF Backlog 571
title: Durable work-state is never committed to develop (a fresh clone shows delivered items as 'new' and lacks new items); auto-checkpoint backlog/issue state per-delivery + periodic batch, with a guard
body: Evidence: on origin/develop BI-PF-0394/BI-PF-0395 = status 'new' (no delivery), BI-PF-1253/54/55 absent, IS-PF-0037 absent; ~96 item + ~60 history + open/closed/counters/id-blocks are uncommitted in the runtime tree. Root cause: the delivery lane and API WRITE durable state (backlog items, indexes, history, counters, issues, id-blocks, delivery provenance) into the runtime tree but NO code path commits/pushes it. Code rides PRs; state does not. A fresh clone therefore cannot resume (redoes delivered work, lacks new items) even though it can run. RCCA guard: automated durable-state checkpoint + a gate that fails if durable state is left uncommitted.

objective: Guarantee durable PF work-state is always on develop: auto-commit+push the durable state after every delivery and on a periodic batch, fail-closed if a checkpoint cannot land, and gate on uncommitted durable state so it can never silently regress.
acceptance_criteria: core/state_checkpoint.py: single writer; allowlist of durable paths only; checkpoint(note) commit+push via protected-branch PR; idempotent no-op when clean; fail-closed on push failure
delivery.deliver() checkpoints provenance+state automatically after merge
periodic batch checkpoint runs from the scheduler for non-delivery mutations
wired_audit/precheck guard flags uncommitted durable state (advisory now, fatal at --release)
.gitignore excludes ephemeral runtime stores so only durable state is ever committed
fresh-clone check: after a delivery, develop shows the item completed with links.delivery
in_scope: core/state_checkpoint.py (durable allowlist + checkpoint + protection-aware push + CLI)
approach: New owner core/state_checkpoint.py: DURABLE paths = data/backlog/{items,history,open.json,closed.json,counters.json}, issues/{items,history,indexes}, config/id-blocks.json, portfolio-registry.json. checkpoint(note): temp worktree off origin/develop -> copy durable diffs -> commit '[data] <note>' -> push branch -> PR -> gh merge -> prune; no-op when clean; fail-closed if commit ok but push fails. Wire into delivery.deliver() post-merge and a scheduler tick; guard via wired_audit.
verification: Objective achieved: Durable work-state is never committed to develop (a fresh clone shows delivered items as 'new' and lacks new items); auto-checkpoint backlog/issue state per-delivery + periodic batch, with a guard
risks: state commit could race a concurrent delivery (serialize with the delivery lock)
protected develop requires the PR path (never direct push)
guard must be advisory to avoid blocking local dev, fatal at release
